# Day-ahead models: all variants, validation period (generated by `scripts/analyze_completion.py`; completion batch)

Task: forecasts issued at 10:00 on day D-1 for the 24 hours of day D (`docs/experiment_protocol.md`, entries of 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20). 4,367 (day, hour) samples, 181 complete days; all models are compared on the same samples. Validation predictions: hyper-parameters and early stopping were chosen on this period, so the numbers are optimistic.
Intervals: 95% paired moving-block bootstrap over whole days (blocks of 28 days, 1,000 resamples).

## 90% prediction intervals for the day-ahead forecasts

Calibrated on the validation period only (in this validation-mode run the calibration and the evaluation period are the same, so the numbers are only a code check); rolling conformal uses only errors of forecasts whose target time is not later than the origin (10:00 on the previous day). Coverage target 90%; interval score = width + 20 x the miss distance (lower is better).

| point forecast | method | coverage % | mean width (MW) | interval score (MW) |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| XGBoost S4, pooled | split conformal (absolute) | 90.0 | 16,143 | 23,830 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 87.5 | 15,938 | 25,448 |
| Ridge | split conformal (absolute) | 90.0 | 16,423 | 24,099 |
| Ridge | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 87.9 | 16,615 | 25,611 |
| LSTM L4, pooled | split conformal (absolute) | 90.0 | 17,478 | 25,151 |
| LSTM L4, pooled | rolling conformal (last 720 errors known at the origin) | 88.2 | 16,781 | 26,400 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | quantile regression, raw 5%-95% | 87.5 | 15,242 | 24,406 |
| XGBoost S4, pooled | quantile regression + CQR | 90.0 | 17,053 | 24,164 |

## Caveats

- 181 complete days from one validation period; intervals reflect day-to-day noise inside the period, not year-to-year variation. The test year has been used several times for declared analyses.
- Scenario A (no forecast weather) except where labelled; the issue time and the availability of the 10:00 demand value are design assumptions.
- XGBoost, LightGBM, the LSTMs and the GRU are pooled over the 24 target hours except where labelled (one model per hour; 24 outputs); tuning budgets differ (see above).
- Statistical models (SARIMAX, Prophet) and convolutional or attention-based networks (TCN, Transformer) were not evaluated (dropped by the owner before any run).
- S6 uses archived temperature forecasts whose issue times were not verified; S5 uses oracle weather and is an upper bound, not an achievable result.
